```artifact
Feature: Patient History File

  Scenario: Patient History File - For a patient, history of consultations done in last 3 years
    Given a patient with a valid ID
    When I retrieve the patient's history of consultations done in the last 3 years
    Then the system should display the patient's history of consultations done in the last 3 years

  Scenario: Patient Registration <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient with a valid ID
    When I attempt to register the patient
    Then the registration process should take <= 4 seconds

  Scenario: Patient Consultation Requests <= 2 seconds
    Given a patient with a valid ID
    When I attempt to make a consultation request
    Then the consultation request process should take <= 2 seconds

  Scenario: Chemist - Prescription Requests <= 2 seconds
    Given a patient with a valid ID and a chemist with a valid ID
    When I attempt to make a prescription request
    Then the prescription request process should take <= 2 seconds

  Scenario: Labs - Lab Requests <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient with a valid ID and a lab with a valid ID
    When I attempt to make a lab request
    Then the lab request process should take <= 4 seconds

  Scenario: Patient - Prescription & Invoice Look-up <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient with a valid ID
    When I attempt to look up the patient's prescription and invoice
    Then the look-up process should take <= 4 seconds

  Scenario Outline: Patient History File - For a patient, history of consultations done in last 3 years (edge cases)
```
